    s = input().strip()
    n = len(s)
    insertions = 0
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j < n and s[j] == s[i]:
            j += 1
        run_length = j - i
        if run_length % 2 == 0:
            insertions += 1
        i = j
    print(insertions)

    main()
